Layers

Terrain

Contour interval changes the thin lines; the heavier 100-ft lines stay. Path and road widths are drawn to scale, measured from the aerial photo (perpendicular brightness profiles across each mapped centreline; segments hidden under tree canopy take the measured median for their type). The aerial is USDA NAIP imagery via USGS, public domain. Solid markers are survey positions from OSM; dashed markers were georeferenced off the official 2026 park map (±10–20 m). Section pieces are a Voronoi partition of the official listings clipped to the built area, so every building falls in exactly one.

Terrain: USGS 3DEP elevation, 1200 × 1000 raster (detail is coarser than the pixel size). Features: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Listings: official Dollywood 2026 park map, 145 numbered entries. Section pieces are derived from the official listings and tile the built area without overlap. Building heights in the 3D view are nominal by type; coaster tracks are shown at ground level because no track elevation data exists.
